from.place: the triangulated category K(A) and the exact localization Q in Situation 05S8

title: The homotopy category of complexes is triangulated
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] and $K(\mathcal A)$ the homotopy category of $\mathbf Z$-indexed cochain complexes of $\mathcal A$ (morphisms of complexes modulo homotopy). With the shift $(K[1])^r=K^{r+1}$, $d_{K[1]}=-d_K$, and with the distinguished triangles those isomorphic to the cone triangles $K\xrightarrow{f}L\xrightarrow{i}C(f)\xrightarrow{-p}K[1]$ of morphisms of complexes $f$ (notation of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]), $K(\mathcal A)$ is a triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category]. Moreover the localization functor $Q:K(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal A)$ commutes with the shifts and carries distinguished triangles to distinguished triangles, i.e. it is an exact functor of triangulated categories.
